## How it works

**During and after each lecture — 1 hour.** Both lecturers stay in the room. No booking, just show up. This is the fastest channel and the one most students should use: the material is fresh and you are already there.

**Online, by appointment — any time.** Always available. Pick a slot on the booking page below; you get a video-call link back.

**Working students.** Prof. Salvini covers working students for **both** modules. Book an online slot and say you are a working student in the note — evening and off-hours slots are opened on request.

## Before you book

A question with a script attached gets answered in five minutes. A question without one takes the whole slot. Bring:

- the code that fails, as a file, not a screenshot
- the exact error message, copied
- what you expected to happen instead

For anything answerable in two lines — a date, an exam rule, where a dataset lives — check the [schedule](index.qmd) and the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd) first, then email.
